info.title: School Management Portal API
info.description: Every route below is generated from this codebase's own Zod validation schemas and its live role-guard tags (the same source src/authorization/authMatrix.data.ts reads) — see src/openapi/. `x-roles` on an operation lists the roles allowed through its role gate; an operation with no `security` requirement is public.

ValidationError.description: The request body/params/query failed schema validation, or violated a business rule (e.g. an invalid state transition, a field that must reference an existing related record).

UnauthorizedError.description: The Authorization header is missing or the access token is invalid/expired — or, for login/refresh specifically, the credentials or refresh token themselves were rejected.

NoRolesAssignedError.description: This account authenticated successfully but holds no roles at all, so no access token was issued. Distinct from an ordinary permission failure — this is an account-provisioning problem an admin needs to fix, not something the caller can route around.

ForbiddenError.description: Authenticated, but not permitted to perform this action — the caller's role(s), or their relationship to the specific resource, don't satisfy this route's guard.

ConflictError.description: The request conflicts with the resource's current state — most commonly a duplicate (unique field already in use) or an action that's already been taken (e.g. a payment already confirmed, an enquiry already converted, a result already finalized).

NotFoundError.description: No resource exists at the given id (or, for a nested path, at that combination of ids).
